title.orig: 浣溪沙（一曲新詞酒一杯）
title.en: To the Tune Huanxisha: A New Song, a Cup of Wine
title.zh: 浣溪沙（一曲新词酒一杯）

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource. Lines broken at the punctuation for reading; text unchanged.
edition.zh: 据维基文库。按标点分行，文字未改。

basis.en: Song dynasty lyric (ci); the author died in 1055.

note.en: Yan Shu was a chief minister of the Northern Song, and his lyrics are quiet, polished and full of leisure. Huanxisha, 'washing silk in the stream', is the name of the tune, not the subject; Song lyrics were written to existing melodies. This one turns on a famous couplet, flowers falling and swallows returning, loss and return in the same breath, which is how the seasons actually work.
note.zh: 晏殊是北宋宰相，他的词安静、精致，带着闲适。“浣溪沙”是词牌，不是题目；宋词是按现成的曲调填写的。这首词的关键是那一联名句：花落去，燕归来，失去与归来同在一口气里，四季本来就是这样运行的。

excerpt.orig: 無可奈何花落去，似曾相識燕歸來。
excerpt.en: Nothing to be done: the flowers fall. / As if I knew them, the swallows come back.
excerpt.zh: 无可奈何花落去，似曾相识燕归来。

gloss.en: A new song lyric, a ci, written to be sung to a tune at a feast.
gloss.zh: 新词：新填的词，在宴席上配乐演唱。

gloss.en: Yan Shu liked this couplet enough to use it again in a regulated poem, Shown to Assistant Zhang and Collator Wang.
gloss.zh: 晏殊很喜欢这一联，又把它用在七律《示张寺丞王校勘》中。

gloss.en: A path fragrant with fallen petals.
gloss.zh: 香径：落花满地、散发香气的小路。

gloss.en: To walk back and forth, unable to leave.
